lines.text: Hamath and Arpad are put to shame over a bad report, and Damascus turns to flee in panic.
Damascus's young men will fall in the streets, and the LORD will set fire to her walls.
Cyrus king of Persia defeated Kedar and the kingdoms of Hazor, and the LORD says to destroy the east.
The LORD says Hazor will become a haunt for jackals, a desolation forever.
The LORD will shatter Elam's chariots, bring the four winds against them, and set His throne in Elam.
